findings.passage: “Voters sent me to Austin with a clear mandate: pass school choice, protect innocent life, and secure our border and elections,” Pierson said. “This session we expanded property-tax relief, safeguarded Texas land from foreign adversaries, strengthened election integrity, fought for the unborn, supported border security, and delivered school choice to thousands of children across Texas.”
findings.note: End-of-session press release, quoted directly. She lists strengthened election integrity among the session's results. The release does not name a bill and does not mention voter ID or citizenship. The same release says she sponsored election integrity legislation from the Senate (the release's wording, not hers).

findings.motion: House cosponsor of SB 16 (proof of citizenship to register to vote); last action 2025-05-25 committee report sent to Calendars
findings.note: She is listed among the House cosponsors of SB 16, 'Relating to requiring a person to submit proof of citizenship to register to vote, including the eligibility of certain voters to vote a limited federal ballot if the voter cannot supply the required proof...; creating criminal offenses.' Date shown is the bill's last House action, not the date she signed on.
